title.para: Installer API, Status Codes, and Local Package Layout

indexterm.primary: Installer API, Status Codes, and Local Package Layout

section.title: Scope
section.para: This chapter covers InstallerStatus and install/remove package operations. Boolean success is insufficient for CLI and API callers. Status enums let callers distinguish already-exists, parse, extract, and I/O failures.

section.title: Installation flow
section.para: Validate bundle path and install root. Extract into staging path. Load and validate manifest. Move staged package into destination by package name. Handle overwrite policy explicitly.

section.title: Removal flow
section.para: Map missing package to InstallerStatus::NotFound. Return RemoveFailed for filesystem errors. Do not silently ignore remove failures.

section.title: Layout expectations
section.para: Packages should live in a destination tree that separates solver, plugin, library, and Lua addon installs. Keep manifest and payload paths predictable. Provide a removal path that can undo a successful install.

section.title: CLI mapping
section.para: sattyre-packman install/remove should print user-facing text by status. Exit codes should be nonzero for non-Ok statuses. Keep status-to-message mapping centralized.

section.title: Chapter summary
section.para: Installer status enums make failures diagnosable. The local package flow becomes deterministic and script-friendly. This is critical before building remote registry pipelines.
